title: Book of the Watchers dated to around 300 BC

tellings.quote: The oldest section, namely the book of the Watchers containing this the the Enochian tale of the Watchers that was written at least cir circa 300 BC.

plain: A researcher named Tim Alberino says on Jesse Michels's podcast that the Book of the Watchers, the oldest part of an ancient Jewish text called 1 Enoch, was written at least around 300 BC. That section tells the tale of beings called the Watchers. He tells it to show how old the story is.
